Author: dajoey
Name: Lazy FATE Automator
Description: Fully automated FATE grinding using vnavmesh IPC, Mount Roulette / Dismount via ActionManager, Gluttony Combo IPC for combat, and a priority-aware sort engine ported from CBT (Croizat's Bundle of Tweaks / Automaton).
Punchline: Fully automated FATE grinding utilizing vnavmesh, lifestream, and Gluttony Combo.
Changelog:
v0.0.2.3 - Implement real zone swap. '/li random' isn't a valid Lifestream command; status flipped to 'Zone dry. Swapping...' but nothing actually happened. New ZoneSwapper enumerates aetherytes from Telepo's authoritative unlocked-aetheryte list (FFXIVClientStructs.FFXIV.Client.Game.UI.Telepo.TeleportList), filters to the player's current expansion + non-PvP + non-housing, picks a random one and issues /tp <name> via TeleporterPlugin. Auto-dismount before teleport.
v0.0.2.2 - Fix landing/takeoff oscillation and post-dismount autorun. (a) Added sticky engagement: once we arrive at a FATE we stay in HandleEngaging until it ends/expires/we drift far away, instead of re-evaluating distance every tick and routing back into mount/flight logic mid-dismount. (b) Arrival check now uses 2D distance + fate.Radius (so descending from flight doesn't fail the 3D-distance arrival threshold). (c) Sticky engagement releases if you drift >60y from the FATE and aren't in combat (lets the plugin recover instead of clinging to a dead target).
v0.0.2.1 - Fix dismount self-cancellation: HandleBetweenFates was re-issuing Dismount() every 1s while waiting for the ~2s cast to complete, cancelling its own cast. Dismount logic moved into HandleEngaging with in-flight tracking + 4s timeout, same pattern as Mount. After 3 failed dismount attempts, abandons the target instead of looping forever.
v0.0.2.0 - Major rewrite. NavigationHelper now uses vnavmesh IPC subscribers (SimpleMove.PathfindAndMoveTo, Path.IsRunning, Query.Mesh.NearestPointReachable) instead of chat commands. Stuck detection uses live navmesh state. FATESolver fixes the operator-precedence bug in NPC matching, drops magic-string sort criteria for a typed enum + descending toggle, and adds a deterministic tiebreaker. State machine re-evaluates the target FATE every tick so higher-priority FATEs preempt mid-path. Configuration has a real Version migration scaffold; bad values are clamped. Tick loop has try/catch with exponential backoff (auto-stops after 5 consecutive errors). New /lazyfate start|stop|toggle|status subcommands. UI: sort-order editor, eligibility highlighting, distance column, Gluttony lease indicator, ImGui % escaping.
v0.0.1.3 - Fix movement stutter.
v0.0.1.2 - Fix mount/dismount enum + IDs.
v0.0.1 - Initial development version.
